notes.title: Minor Patch Updates - Jul 14 2023
notes.notes:
macOS build now Apple Silicon and x86_64 native and notarized
 Improvements to some dialogue UI Appearances
 Volume slider in options (replaces Sound On/Off toggle control)
 Small bugfixes

notes.title: Dec 7th Release date announced!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30916106/09a9a6df456a4d375e94943610b39c4524b0410c.gif

I know we said final steps a few weeks ago, but a CPU knocked us off course there for a few cycles. 

We're super psyched to announce Dec 7th as our launch date and we're planning a special stearming event online so players can join us for a nostalgic playthrough of some of our favourite scenes from past episodes. 

Stay tuned for links and specific times etc.. Also if there are scenes you'd like to see us play discuss please leave it in the comments!

xo
